title: Creamy Bacon-Wrapped Chicken
description: Chicken breasts are rolled around a cream cheese filling and wrapped in bacon for a rich and savory main dish.
ingredients: salt and ground black pepper to taste
6 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - pounded 1/4 inch thick

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C). Set a wired rack into a baking dish.
Mix together cream cheese and green onions in a bowl until well combined; season with salt and black pepper.

Spread about 1/4 cup cream cheese mixture over each chicken breast. Starting at the narrow end, roll chicken breasts over filling. Wrap each chicken breast in 4 slices of bacon. Place wrapped chicken onto the rack in the prepared dish.
Bake in the preheated oven until bacon is browned, about 1 hour. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center of a breast should read at least 165 degrees F (74 degrees C).
